summary: Projects dashboard UX/UI reframe. Promotes owner-facing project groups into primary views, moves entry/status/type into one advanced filter control, hides archived/retired rows from the default current-work list while preserving lifecycle filters, removes synthetic abbreviation tiles, and raises project name/description/metadata readability. Existing Git/source authority, attention/repair actions, canonical data, schema, auth/security, Shared Shell/Navigation and updater mechanism are unchanged. Release-gate reconciliation restored the shared 无需处理 action-state language and aligned superseded contracts without changing approved product behavior. OWNER explicitly requested continued publication. OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE applies as a bounded presentation-only UI release; Preview and Real Use remain post-release/post-production requirements. Production remains Owner manual.
